item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01695","case1_error":"Reports one company's $36,000 cost as the combined cost, omitting the other two companies.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written sum 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"The first omits the three-company aggregation; the second makes an explicit numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01696","case1_error":"Gives unsupported $475 after correct cost formulas; the formulas yield $752.","case2_error":"Multiplies the eight-party total by eight again, duplicating the party-count factor; final numbers also lack valid evaluation.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second explicitly introduces an erroneous extra multiplication.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01697","case1_error":"Uses three grams per small antacid instead of the stated one gram, confusing pill count with individual weight.","case2_error":"Uses all 30 students as the last group's size instead of subtracting the first two groups to obtain five.","reason":"The first substitutes a count for an individual weight; the second substitutes the whole population for a remaining subgroup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01698","case1_error":"Treats four bags as four peanuts, ignoring the 30 peanuts per bag.","case2_error":"Reports the two-hour detour duration as the entire trip duration, omitting the normal three-hour trip.","reason":"The first confuses container count with item count; the second answers with an additional duration instead of the requested total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01699","case1_error":"Gives unsupported $475 after correct cost formulas; the formulas yield $752.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported $55.50 after correct revenue formulas; the formulas yield $88.","reason":"Both present correct formulas followed by an incorrect final number without showing the calculation that produced it.","judgment":"same"}]}
